descriptors.definition: Joint auditors must issue a common audit report unless there is a disagreement over the opinion or report matters, in which case each dissenting auditor expresses an independent opinion in a separate report. Such separate reports must be cross-referenced under the Other Matter Paragraph.
inclusion: Issuance of common audit report by joint auditors
Expression of separate opinions in case of disagreement
Cross-referencing using Other Matter Paragraph
exclusion: Consolidated single opinion reporting when unanimous agreement exists
nearby_distinctions: Differs from standard single auditor reporting by requiring coordination and formal cross-references for dissenting views.

descriptors.concept_name: Communication with Those Charged with Governance
descriptors.definition: Auditors must communicate expected opinion modifications, including the underlying circumstances and proposed wording, directly to those charged with governance to ensure adherence to reporting standards. Similar communication is mandated when an Emphasis of Matter or Other Matter paragraph is anticipated.
inclusion: Communicating anticipated audit report modifications
Disclosing proposed wording for modified opinions
Discussing planned Emphasis of Matter or Other Matter paragraphs
exclusion: Routine operational audit findings without report modification implications
nearby_distinctions: Focuses specifically on reporting changes and modifications rather than general audit strategy execution.

descriptors.concept_name: SA 402 Audit Considerations Relating to an Entity Using a Service Organisation
descriptors.definition: This standard governs the user auditor's responsibility to gather sufficient appropriate audit evidence when a user entity utilizes outsourced services from one or more service organizations. It specifically guides how the user auditor applies risk assessment and response standards to evaluate outsourced information systems and relevant internal controls.
inclusion: Assessing risks associated with outsourced business functions
Evaluating service organization controls integrated into the user entity's information system
exclusion: Direct auditing of service organizations without establishing user entity financial reporting relevance
nearby_distinctions: Applies specifically to third-party outsourced processing environments rather than internal client-operated units.

descriptors.concept_name: Objectives of User Auditor in accordance with SA 402
descriptors.definition: The user auditor must understand the nature and significance of outsourced services and their impact on relevant internal controls to identify and assess material misstatement risks. Additionally, the auditor is required to design and implement appropriate audit procedures responsive to those assessed risks.
inclusion: Gaining an understanding of service organization effects on internal controls
Designing and executing responsive audit procedures
exclusion: Assuming internal controls are effective without performing evaluative procedures
nearby_distinctions: Centers directly on auditor objectives regarding outsourced service impacts rather than general risk assessment tasks.

descriptors.definition: A Type 1 report provides a service auditor's opinion on the description, design, and implementation of a service organization's controls as of a specific date. A Type 2 report extends this assurance by including an opinion on the operating effectiveness of those controls throughout a specified period, alongside a description of actual tests performed.
inclusion: Evaluation of control design and implementation for Type 1
Evaluation of control operating effectiveness and test descriptions for Type 2
exclusion: Management representation letters replacing independent service auditor reports
nearby_distinctions: Type 1 assesses design and implementation at a point in time, whereas Type 2 additionally evaluates operational effectiveness over a period.

descriptors.concept_name: Obtaining an Understanding of the Services
descriptors.definition: When executing risk assessments under SA 315, the user auditor must examine how the user entity integrates service organization functions into its operations. This entails analyzing the nature and significance of the outsourced services and identifying the affected financial reporting processes and accounts.
inclusion: Evaluating the significance of outsourced operations
Identifying material transactions and accounts processed by service providers
exclusion: Ignoring outsourced processes that do not impact financial reporting
nearby_distinctions: Focuses on building the foundational understanding of outsourced services prior to detailed control testing.

descriptors.definition: To utilize a Type 1 or Type 2 report as audit evidence, the user auditor must verify the service auditor's professional competence, independence, and the adequacy of reporting standards. Alternative evidence collection methods include direct contact, site visits, or engaging another auditor when reports are unavailable.
inclusion: Verifying service auditor competence and independence
Alternative procedures such as site visits or using another auditor
exclusion: Accepting service auditor reports without assessing standard adequacy
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between relying on existing third-party service reports versus performing direct procedures at the service organization.

descriptors.concept_name: Responding to the Assessed Risks of Material Misstatement
descriptors.definition: The user auditor must evaluate whether sufficient appropriate audit evidence concerning financial statement assertions is accessible via user entity records. If local records are insufficient, further audit procedures or another auditor must be utilized to perform tests at the service organization.
inclusion: Determining availability of audit evidence at user entity
Executing further audit procedures at the service organization
exclusion: Relying solely on management assertions without corroborative testing
nearby_distinctions: Emphasizes active response strategies when local entity records fail to provide complete verification for outsourced activities.

descriptors.definition: When expecting service organization controls to operate effectively, the user auditor gathers operating effectiveness evidence through appropriate testing methods. This involves evaluating control design dates, assessing evidence sufficiency, and identifying relevant complementary user entity controls.
inclusion: Obtaining Type 2 reports for operating effectiveness evidence
Performing direct tests of controls at the service organization
exclusion: Assuming control operating effectiveness without empirical testing
nearby_distinctions: Focuses specifically on verifying control operational performance rather than merely reviewing design implementation.

descriptors.concept_name: Fraud, Non-Compliance with Laws and Regulations and Uncorrected Misstatements in relation to Activities at the Service Organisation
descriptors.definition: The user auditor must inquire with user entity management regarding any reported fraud, regulatory non-compliance, or uncorrected misstatements originating from the service organization. The auditor then evaluates how these external events impact further audit procedures and overall reporting conclusions.
inclusion: Inquiring about service organization fraud or non-compliance incidents
Evaluating the impact of reported errors on audit scope and conclusions
exclusion: Disregarding compliance issues reported by third-party service providers
nearby_distinctions: Concentrates on compliance failures and irregularities occurring within outsourced operational environments.

descriptors.definition: If the user auditor cannot obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence regarding outsourced service activities, the opinion must be modified in accordance with standard requirements. Furthermore, references to a service auditor's work in an unmodified report are strictly prohibited unless mandated by law.
inclusion: Modifying the audit opinion due to insufficient evidence from service organizations
Restricting references to service auditors in unmodified reports
exclusion: Voluntarily referencing the service auditor in an unmodified report
nearby_distinctions: Governs explicit disclosure boundaries within the final audit report regarding reliance on external service auditors.
